evals.prompt: Before I install it, check whether the skill in evals/files/broken-skill/ is valid.
evals.expected_output: Runs the validator and reports every error with its fix: the name format, the name differing from the folder, the XML tag in the description, the unquoted metadata version and the broken reference link. Does not install the skill.

evals.prompt: I wrote a skill for our changelog format. How do I know if it actually helps? Set up the tests.
evals.expected_output: Creates evals/evals.json with 2-3 realistic cases and evals/trigger-queries.json with should-trigger queries and near misses split into train and validation, explains the with/without-skill runs in fresh sessions, and asks before starting any paid agent sessions.
